turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I didn't come for thanks. Who decided, and on what basis?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Version history of what, and when did you pull it, before the zero went in or after? Turn the screen so I can read it myself. Dates, times, and whose account.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I be shown the version history you mentioned with its dates and times, and that nothing about this go on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing, because the version history was mentioned but never shown.
